reviewed_by: a native speaker of Hindi, via the project owner
note: Reviewed by a native speaker of Hindi on 16 October 2026 (D175). Three decisions recorded here. Punctuation stays the full stop: the reviewer's finding is that the danda '।' is technically correct standard Hindi and that either is acceptable if used consistently, while '.' is what urban Mumbai Hindi uses on WhatsApp and alongside Latin ward codes — so the platform uses one convention across both languages. प्राधिकरण is replaced by संबंधित विभाग in prose and विभाग: as the label; nobody in Mumbai says प्राधिकरण को बताया गया. The status lines say काम पूरा होने rather than ठीक होने, so they fit garbage and a felled tree as well as a pothole. One value departs from the review: 'effluent discharge' is दूषित पानी छोड़ना rather than गंदा रासायनिक पानी छोड़ना, because a photograph does not establish that a discharge is chemical, and the Marathi (दूषित सांडपाणी सोडणे) makes no such claim either.
